coverage_notes: All 115 supplied complete observations and all 65 CSV rows were considered. Visually inspected Table 5, every registered Fig. 2/5/6 location, captions, Table 1 and relevant methods/discussion. No visual-access limitation. No paper-wide census, unregistered curve thresholds, composition enrichment or input edits. Page 2 was rendered but not viewed and is not counted as inspected. CRA scan-rate/procedure and chloride-molarity fields were not needed for identity and are not certified.
shared_qualifications: Q1 — Table 5 (PDF p. 7), Fig. 5 (p. 12) and results (p. 6) label concentration as Cl−; CRA solution cells label the same nominal 300/500/1000/5000 numbers as ppm NaCl. Methods (p. 3) describe aqueous NaCl preparation at pH 7.8 without resolving this basis conflict. Table-grid identities use alloy, nominal category, temperature and Epit together; ppm salt and ppm chloride are not declared equivalent. No chloride-molarity conversion or electrode offset was used; values are mV versus SCE (p. 4).

C1 — Fig. 5 uses log10 chloride concentration in ppm: 10^2.5=316.227766, 10^3=1000, 10^3.5=3162.277660 and 10^4=10000 ppm. Table 5 categories have log10 values 2.477121, 2.698970, 3 and 3.698970. These are arithmetic comparisons, not salt-to-chloride or molarity conversions.

Q2 — Fig. 5 obs_077-079, 081-083, 085-087, 089-091, 093-095, 097-099, 101-103, 109-111 and 113-115 remain candidate-only. Its printed x=3/3.5/4 positions conflict with the nominal concentrations of the potential-compatible Table 5 presentations. At x=3, retain the nominal-1000-ppm counterpart as well as compatible repeated-presentation alternatives; some flat series retain several potential-compatible values. Approximate equality alone does not assign identity; no ordinal point mapping or source correction is made.

Q3 — Nine first Fig. 5 points (obs_076, 080, 084, 088, 092, 096, 100, 108, 112) have x≈2.5 compatible with the nominal-300-ppm category and the corresponding Table 5 Epit. Supported shared rows are CRA 1, 6, 11, 16, 31, 41, 46, 61 and 36, respectively. These are compatible possible repeated presentations, not summary members or proven duplicate runs; do not count the shared CRA rows twice.

Q4 — Identity is separate from numerical agreement. Obs_030/CRA 30 retains Table 5 1516 mV, Fig. 2 94 mV and Fig. 6 ≈160 mV; obs_075/CRA 65 retains Table 5 629, Fig. 2 826 and Fig. 6 ≈630 mV. Obs_035/CRA 35 retains Table 5 813 versus Fig. 6 ≈720 mV; obs_065/CRA 60 retains Table 5 721 versus Fig. 6 ≈820 mV. The latter two Fig. 6 PREN coordinates also differ from Table 5; its Monit label is 44653 versus 44635 in Tables 1/5. All four links are marked discrepant, although their primary table values exactly equal CRA. No primary reading, label or potential is repaired or reassigned.

Q5 — PDF p. 6 defines Epit by a consistent current-density increase indicating non-passivating pits. CRA Avg is a storage-column label; the matched table cells are reported single values, not established means. Blank CRA Min/Max are preserved. Remanit 4565 and 4575 observations have no counterpart in this CSV, which does not imply their absence from the paper. These proposals do not identify the presentation used by the original curators.
